contentHtml:
For the large Pakistani expatriate community in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, keeping travel documents up to date is a priority to ensure a smooth residency (Iqama) status. The process for renewing a Machine Readable Passport (MRP) has been modernized, allowing for both in-person visits to the Embassy or Consulate and online renewals through the official government portal.

At Connect Resources, we provide the necessary information to help global talent manage their administrative requirements efficiently. This guide details the current pakistani passport fees in saudi arabia and how to use the passport tracking pakistan by token number online service.

1. Pakistani Passport Renewal Fees in Saudi Arabia

The fees for passport renewal depend on two factors: the validity period (5 or 10 years) and the processing priority (Normal or Urgent).

Fee Structure (36 Pages)

Validity Category Estimated Fee (SAR)*
5 Years Normal Approx. 135 – 155
5 Years Urgent Approx. 225 – 250
10 Years Normal Approx. 200 – 225
10 Years Urgent Approx. 335 – 360

Note: Fees are subject to change based on exchange rates and specific consular service charges. For 72-page or 100-page booklets, the fees increase accordingly.

2. How to Track Your Passport Online by Token Number

Once you have completed your application at the Embassy in Riyadh or the Consulate in Jeddah, you will receive a Token Receipt. This document contains an 11-digit number essential for monitoring your application’s progress.

Steps for Passport Tracking:

  1. Visit the Official Portal: Go to the Directorate General of Immigration & Passports (DGI&P) tracking page or the specific tracking link provided by the Pakistan Embassy in KSA.

  2. Enter the Token Number: Input the 11-digit number found on your receipt.

  3. Check Status: The system will display the current stage of your passport, such as “In Process,” “Printed,” or “Sent to Mission.”

Tip: If the status shows “Complete” or “Ready for Collection,” you can proceed to the designated collection counter at the Embassy or Consulate with your original token and old passport.

3. Important Renewal Rules and Requirements

When applying for a pakistani passport renewal in Saudi Arabia, ensure you have the following ready:

  • Original CNIC/NICOP: A valid National Identity Card for Overseas Pakistanis is mandatory.

  • Old Passport: You must present your most recent passport (and a copy of the first two pages).

  • Iqama Copy: Proof of residency in Saudi Arabia.

  • Digital Photos: If applying online, you will need a digital photograph with a white background that meets specific size requirements.

4. Online Renewal vs. In-Person Appointment

  • Online (E-Passport/MRP): You can renew your passport via the Online MRP Portal. This is ideal for those living far from Riyadh or Jeddah, as the new passport can be delivered via DHL to your doorstep (additional shipping fees apply).

  • In-Person: Recommended if your personal data (name, father’s name, or date of birth) requires modification, or if your previous passport has been lost or severely damaged.

5. How Connect Resources Supports Your Transition

Managing international documentation is just one part of a successful career in the Kingdom. Connect Resources assists companies and individuals in:

  • Visa & PRO Services: Navigating the complexities of Saudi labor and immigration laws.

  • EOR Services: Helping international firms hire Pakistani talent in KSA with full legal compliance.

  • Onboarding Support: Ensuring that all residency and work documents are aligned with current regulations.

6. Conclusion: Staying Compliant

Understanding the pakistani passport renewal fees in saudi arabia and utilizing the passport tracking pakistan by token number online system ensures that you avoid late renewal penalties and potential issues with your Iqama. Always check the official Embassy of Pakistan Riyadh website for the most recent announcements regarding holiday closures or fee adjustments.

FAQ: Pakistani Passports in KSA

Q1: How long does it take to receive a renewed passport in Saudi Arabia?

Normal processing usually takes 20 to 25 working days, while the Urgent service takes approximately 10 to 12 working days.

Q2: Can I renew my passport if my NICOP has expired?

No. You must first renew your NICOP through the NADRA portal before you can initiate a passport renewal.

Q3: What should I do if I lose my passport in Saudi Arabia?

You must report the loss to the local police and obtain a report. Then, visit the Embassy or Consulate in person to apply for a “Lost Category” replacement, which carries higher fees.
